columns.open_time: Opening timestamp of the hourly candle
columns.high: Highest BTC price during the hour in USDT
columns.low: Lowest BTC price during the hour in USDT
columns.volume: Total BTC volume traded during the hour
columns.taker_buy_volume: BTC volume from taker buy trades during the hour

derived_features.return_1h: Percentage price change from the previous hour
derived_features.volatility_24h: Standard deviation of the previous 24 hourly returns
derived_features.taker_buy_ratio: Taker buy volume divided by total volume

data_cleaning: Converted open_time from Unix milliseconds to datetime
Checked for physically invalid price and volume values
